title: AI Assistant — Prompt Templates
description: Create prompt templates for research plan drafting, result explanation, report generation, and risk checklist. All templates respect agent boundary.
action: Create synapse/agent/prompts.py with 4 prompt template functions: (1) draft_research_plan(hypothesis) -> str; (2) explain_results(experiment_record, audit_result, backtest_result) -> str; (3) draft_report(factor_spec, audit_result, backtest_result) -> str; (4) generate_risk_checklist(experiment_record) -> str. All outputs must include created_by: ai metadata note. Templates must NOT include trade execution, silent modification, or governance bypass instructions.
implementation: Create synapse/agent/prompts.py: four functions returning formatted prompt strings
Each prompt includes context injection points (f-strings with experiment/factor/backtest data)
Each prompt includes system instruction: 'You are a research assistant. You must not execute trades, modify experiment records, or bypass governance checks.'
Risk checklist prompt covers: look-ahead bias, survivorship bias, transaction costs, overfitting, regime dependency, sample size
Write test_prompts.py: verify each function returns non-empty string, verify agent boundary instructions present

criteria: synapse/agent/prompts.py contains 'def draft_research_plan(' and 'def explain_results(' and 'def draft_report(' and 'def generate_risk_checklist('
synapse/agent/prompts.py contains 'must not execute trades' or 'must not modify experiment records'
synapse/agent/prompts.py contains 'created_by' and 'ai' in each template output
